chateau-rear.note: WITHDRAWN FROM USE. The print carries an unremoved photographer's stamp in the lower left — "Photo by / [Re]v C. Lenskold / Floral Park" (Floral Park is on Long Island, New York) — together with pencil crop marks reading "Crop", "K" and "5/8". The likeliest explanation is a copy print made in New York for the Roosevelt Memorial Association and marked up for the printer, but that could not be established from any source available here. Until a Long Island credit on a Medora photograph can be explained, do not publish this image.
